?            Help

Ctrl-S       Save

Ctrl-W       Toggle Wide

Shift-E      Events
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-Q      Quotas
Shift-S      Sort Status
c            Copy

key-272      Help
